title: His youngest sister's marriage and her Jehovah's Witness faith
summary: His sister married a prize fighter, had ten children, and became a Jehovah's Witness, which disappointed him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: my sister, my little sister she was in the mind she wanted to get married almost at the time she got to New York. She run into somebody and he was a prize fighter and I didn't know it and they didn't tell me nothing about it until after they were already engaged to get married, and they got married. I can't do nothing about it, the only time I could do something about it is when they needed some money to pay the rent that he couldn't fight and get no money to pay. So my mother through me and I said I would do something for my sister 'cause my mother says so-and-so-and-so. So I took care of that proposition with them. My sister's got ten children and got about nine grands and they still live in Jamaica. She only moved one time since I put her in the house I got for them. And all the children are married and got families.
So altogether she turned out to surprise me because she turned out to be a Jehovah's Witness and I didn't want her to do that, I was disappointed that she changed from

what religion she was, from Baptist to the religion she had finally chosen. But what can I say. So I let her go ahead. And they don't want you to visit your cemetery, they don't want you to recognize the birthdays, they don't recognize nothing. That's that Jehovah Witness belief -- Kingdom Hall and all that. She spends more time knocking on people's doors to tell them about the Bible than she does finding out whether her children are right or wrong. So half of her kids are going the wrong way because of that. What can I do -- nothing.
